reported_success.quote: We succeeded in replicating the main effect, as well as all significant differences between story types for knowledge ascription that the authors obtained in the original study.

notes: Primary project table independently identifies the same target GEE test (row Nagel et al. (2013), ReplicationANALYSIS). Test statistic and p extracted from the matched report; no coefficient substituted.
